stageGates.gate_purpose: Evaluate the initial AI or software idea against business strategy, operational demand, regulatory feasibility, and initial value potential before committing capital.
stageGates.action_1_text: Evaluate the initial AI/software idea against business strategy and operational demand.
stageGates.action_2_text: Verify regulatory feasibility and initial value potential before committing resources.
stageGates.action_3_text: Secure capital investment and establish asset management leadership.
stageGates.notes: ISO lines are mappings shown in supplied slides, not ISO 55000 clause numbers.

stageGates.gate_purpose: Define functional/technical RAMS specifications, data governance standards, cybersecurity/ethical requirements, and procurement/resourcing plans.
stageGates.action_1_text: Define functional and technical RAMS specifications (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety).
stageGates.action_2_text: Set strict data governance, cybersecurity, and ethical requirements.
stageGates.action_3_text: Plan procurement strategy, supply chain management, and team resourcing.
stageGates.notes: ISO lines are mappings shown in supplied slides, not ISO 55000 clause numbers.

stageGates.gate_purpose: Develop code, train/validate AI algorithms, integrate components, verify data quality, and conduct rigorous testing against the Systems Engineering V-diagram (including Factory Acceptance Testing, RAMS verification, and trial proving).
stageGates.action_1_text: Develop the code, acquire assets, and train/validate the AI algorithms.
stageGates.action_2_text: Verify data quality and information management standards.
stageGates.action_3_text: Conduct rigorous testing against the Systems Engineering V-diagram (including Acceptance Testing, RAMS verification, and trial proving).
stageGates.notes: ISO lines are mappings shown in supplied slides, not ISO 55000 clause numbers.

stageGates.gate_purpose: Formally commission the AI/software solution into live railway operations, integrate it with core enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, IBM Maximo), establish operational support rotas, and train end users.
stageGates.action_1_text: Formally integrate the AI solution into core enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, IBM Maximo).
stageGates.action_2_text: Establish live fault-response plans and operational support rotas.
stageGates.action_3_text: Train end-users, manage organizational change, and adapt company culture for the new tool.
stageGates.notes: ISO lines are mappings shown in supplied slides, not ISO 55000 clause numbers.

stageGates.gate_purpose: Monitor software health, AI model drift, telemetry, and accuracy over time, execute maintenance/retraining updates, and systematically manage outages and downtime.
stageGates.action_1_text: Monitor software health, telemetry, AI model drift, and accuracy over time.
stageGates.action_2_text: Execute routine maintenance, software updates, and model retraining.
stageGates.action_3_text: Manage shutdowns, outages, and system downtime systematically.
stageGates.notes: ISO lines are mappings shown in supplied slides, not ISO 55000 clause numbers.

stageGates.gate_purpose: Phase out legacy software/AI models due to obsolescence or technology upgrades, archive or sanitize data, fulfil legal/data compliance mandates, and transition workflows to replacement solutions without operational loss.
stageGates.action_1_text: Phase out legacy software and AI models due to obsolescence or technology upgrades.
stageGates.action_2_text: Archive or sanitize data to fulfil strict legal and compliance mandates.
stageGates.action_3_text: Transition workflows to replacement solutions without loss, while managing residual liabilities and asset write-offs.
stageGates.notes: ISO lines are mappings shown in supplied slides, not ISO 55000 clause numbers.
